coin.title: Malta 10 Euro "EuroPride" 2023 Silver Prooflike PL68
coin.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=T3XD8DR]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Want a perfect Malta 10 Euro Silver Prooflike in capsule? PL68 coins offer a radiant mirror finish with only tiny imperfections. This coin is eye-catching and full of character: it will stand out in any collection. This Silver coin is a fine example of premium prooflike quality. Design The €10 “EuroPride Malta” Silver Prooflike coin is even more cheerful than the issue in coincard. The coin features rainbow coloured detailing on the letters forming the word ‘PRIDE’. The reverse of the coin shows the coat of arms of the Central Bank of Malta and the date 2023.
